title: project.record — input
description: Append a note, or propose a registry change. Both are proposals; neither is canon.

owner.description: Who is writing. Required and has no default: this provider does not manufacture caller identity, and a write that could claim the operator's authority by omission is the defect the requirement exists to refuse.

statement.description: The minimal claim or episode. A full transcript is evidence, and evidence is linked rather than stored.

why.description: What it meant. The field no diff contains.

memoryId.description: Correct an existing record; requires expectedRevision.

expectedRevision.description: The revision the caller read. A mismatch returns a conflict; there is no last-write-wins.

targetId.description: For a registry proposal: project:… | repository:… | domain:…

patch.description: For a registry proposal: the fields to change.
